subject: [PATCH v4 1/3] mm: swap: move LRU insertion out of the swap cache allocator

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch moves the insertion of a folio into the LRU (Least Recently Used) list out of the swap cache allocator, allowing callers to decide when to add it to the LRU or free it directly. This change is necessary for zswap writeback, which requires a swap cache folio that can be freed immediately after writeback completes. The patch updates several functions in mm/swap_state.c and mm/zswap.c to reflect this change.
